privacy.title: Your privacy
privacy.intro: HealingMuse collects only what is needed for your optional account and listening features.
privacy.accounts: Accounts use your email address for passwordless sign-in. Favorites and playlists belong to your account.
privacy.mood: Mood check-ins require separate consent, are accessible only to their owner through the application, and are automatically removed after 90 days. You can delete them sooner in Mood History or Settings.
privacy.offline: Downloaded recordings and their credits are stored on your device. Account data and mood values are not stored for offline use. Remove device downloads separately when using a shared device.
privacy.providers: Account and media services use Supabase, Backblaze B2 and Vercel. If you choose to load a YouTube player or open Spotify, that service processes information under its own terms and privacy policy.
privacy.logs: Operational logs use error categories and do not contain mood values, emails, signed playback URLs, or request bodies.
privacy.delete: Delete your account in Settings to remove personal application records. Provider backups expire under their retention policies, and restorations must reapply deletions before being used.
privacy.termsIntro: HealingMuse offers music for recreation and emotional support. It does not diagnose conditions, provide medical advice, or replace professional care.
privacy.choice: You choose what to listen to and when to stop. Keep the volume comfortable and pause whenever you prefer.
privacy.rights: Recording credits and licenses are available in each recording's details and accompany offline downloads. Permitted use depends on the recording's license.
privacy.external: External services may show ads, require accounts, or make content unavailable. YouTube videos must remain visible during playback and cannot be downloaded through HealingMuse.
privacy.age: This pilot is intended for adults. Please use only your own account and avoid entering medical records or identifying patient information into playlist names.
privacy.support: For help with the pilot or privacy requests, contact your pilot organizer.
